title: Bundle demo library: one interest
description: Demo content only (decision D4): never used as lessons or exam data. One file per interest. Each chat has a casually typed opening question, a reply of at most 60 words, a short title for the sidebar, and a paraphrase of the question for the find-your-chat challenge. Each thread has a continuation reply of at most 80 words with {{chat:N}} slots that the demo fills with the titles of the thread's earlier chats actually present in the bundle.

title.description: Two to seven words, sentence case, as a chat sidebar would show it.

question.description: Catchy, casually typed opening question (lower case and light typos welcome).

reply.description: At most 60 words. General, non-diagnostic for health and money.

paraphrase.description: A rewording of the question that shares few words with the title, used in 'Find the chat where you asked about…'.

topic.description: What the thread is about, e.g. "Training for a first half marathon".

chats.description: In the order they were asked, over several months.

question.description: A natural follow-up the visitor taps when they reopen the found chat.

reply.description: At most 80 words, counting each slot as two words. Contains two to four slots {{chat:N}} (N = 1..8, the position of an earlier chat in this thread). The demo replaces each slot with that chat's title.
